title.narrative: KUNGAHARA: Resilient Systems for Food and Nutrition

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Action (impact) is to contribute to resilient food systems

and improved food and nutrition security in Rwanda. To tackle the different factors hindering food availability

and nutrition, the Action will enact change at every level of the food system ¿ production, aggregation,

processing, distribution and consumption, through two complementary outcomes: Equitable, sustainable,

inclusive, productive and nutrition-sensitive value chains are enhanced for women and men smallholder

farmers ¿ Outcome 1; and Vulnerable households, and women and children in particular, consume more

diverse, nutrient rich foods ¿ Outcome 2.
